text: Java is a ______ programming language.
explanation: Java follows the object-oriented programming paradigm.

text: A class in Java contains:
explanation: A class contains both data members (variables) and methods.

text: Which keyword is used to define a class in Java?
explanation: The 'class' keyword is used to define a class in Java.

text: An object is created in Java using which keyword?
explanation: The 'new' keyword allocates memory for an object.

text: Variables defined inside a class but outside methods are called:
explanation: Instance variables are declared inside a class but outside methods.

text: Memory for objects in Java is allocated in:
explanation: Objects are allocated memory in the heap area.

text: Which method is automatically called when an object is created?
explanation: Constructors are automatically invoked when an object is created.

text: Instance variables are initialized with:
explanation: Instance variables get default values automatically.

text: Which variable is shared by all objects of a class?
explanation: Static variables are shared among all objects of a class.

text: Class variables are also known as:
explanation: Class variables use the static keyword.

text: How many times is memory allocated for a static variable?
explanation: Static variables are allocated memory only once per class.

text: Which operator is used to access instance members?
explanation: The dot (.) operator is used to access instance members.

text: A reference variable stores:
explanation: Reference variables store the memory address of an object.

text: Declaring an object variable without using new means:
explanation: Without 'new', the reference variable remains null.

text: Which of the following is NOT an instance method?
explanation: main() is a static method, not an instance method.

text: Static methods belong to:
explanation: Static methods belong to the class, not objects.

text: Which method can be called without creating an object?
explanation: Static methods can be called using the class name.

text: Which of the following cannot access instance variables directly?
explanation: Static methods cannot directly access instance variables.

text: Method overloading is an example of:
explanation: Method overloading demonstrates compile-time polymorphism.

text: Local variables are created when:
explanation: Local variables are created during method execution.

text: Local variables are stored in:
explanation: Local variables are stored in stack memory.

text: Which variable has the shortest lifetime?
explanation: Local variables exist only during method execution.

text: Garbage collection in Java is used to:
explanation: Garbage collection frees memory used by unused objects.

text: Each object instance has:
explanation: Each object maintains its own copy of instance variables.

text: The main() method is:
explanation: main() is declared static in Java.

text: A class is best described as:
explanation: A class is a blueprint for creating objects.

text: An object is an instance of:
explanation: Objects are instances of a class.

text: Which memory area stores instance variables?
explanation: Instance variables are stored in heap memory.

text: Default value of an object reference is:
explanation: Object references default to null.

text: Which statement is TRUE?
choices: Object is an instance of class
explanation: Objects are instances created from classes.
